rx.text:
Syp cough suppressant 5 ml three times daily for 5 days
Advise: chest X-ray if not better in a week.
rx.author: Dr Mock B

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: Your angiogram shows a severe block in the main artery on the front of the heart.
turns.en: Your angiogram shows a severe block in the main artery on the front of the heart.

turns.speaker: A
turns.orig: So what do we do now, doctor?
turns.en: So what do we do now, doctor?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: I want to put a stent in it, that is angioplasty. We go in through the wrist with a thin tube, open the block with a balloon and leave a small mesh tube. You will be awake, and you go home the next day.
turns.en: I want to put a stent in it, that is angioplasty. We go in through the wrist with a thin tube, open the block with a balloon and leave a small mesh tube. You will be awake, and you go home the next day.

turns.speaker: A
turns.orig: Is it dangerous? Is there a risk?
turns.en: Is it dangerous? Is there a risk?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: There is a small risk, less than one in a hundred. The risk of leaving this block is higher. I would not delay this beyond this week.
turns.en: There is a small risk, less than one in a hundred. The risk of leaving this block is higher. I would not delay this beyond this week.

turns.speaker: A
turns.orig: The cost, how much will it be?
turns.en: The cost, how much will it be?

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: With the stent about one lakh and ten thousand. The counter will give you the estimate.
turns.en: With the stent about one lakh and ten thousand. The counter will give you the estimate.

turns.speaker: A
turns.orig: We will do it. Please book the earliest slot.
turns.en: We will do it. Please book the earliest slot.

turns.speaker: doctor
turns.orig: Good. Admit tomorrow morning, fasting from midnight.
turns.en: Good. Admit tomorrow morning, fasting from midnight.
